evidence: Has Mining label and modifies WaitAndCreateNewBlock timeout logic in src/node/block_template_manager.cpp.
rationale: Prevents wall clock shifts from altering wait durations and avoids infinite hangs during frozen mocktime tests. As the commit note states, 'waitNext measures its timeout and 1-second fee tick with the wall clock... this means a wall clock jump changes how long waitNext waits, and it never times out while mocktime is frozen.'
